generation_transport: PixelLab MCP via mcp-remote and https://api.pixellab.ai/mcp
prompt_composition: The exact description sent to PixelLab is common_prompt, one space, then the asset prompt below.
common_prompt: Pixel art game resource for Tumble Toy, a cute handmade toy-block puzzle game. Pastel sky blue, cream, mint, peach, coral-pink and dark-plum palette; crisp hard pixels; simple readable shapes; charming toy-room style; no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no photorealism, no smooth antialiasing.

assets.prompt: Use the supplied blank isometric cube silhouette exactly. A single blank six-sided toy die body in quarter view, cream top face, mint left face, peach right face, compact 1-pixel dark-plum outline, centered with a transparent margin. Absolutely no pips, dots, holes, spots, highlights, scratches, numerals or symbols anywhere; every visible face must be a single flat blank color for code-rendered values.

Use the supplied simple isometric tile silhouette exactly. A single plain seamless quarter-view toy building-block floor tile, warm cream diamond top with shallow peach side faces and clear edge separation, centered with a transparent margin. Flat undecorated faces only: no icing, cracks, plants, objects, symbols or surface pattern.

Preserve the supplied approved goal-tile composition. A single flat quarter-view diamond goal marker, thick coral-pink outer ring and blank pale-cream center reserved for a code-rendered number, centered with a transparent margin, no numeral or symbol.

Use the supplied dark diamond silhouette exactly. A single empty-space indicator for a quarter-view board: clean flat dark-plum diamond-shaped shadow, clearly distinct from a floor block, centered with a transparent margin. No object, debris, structure, character, hole interior, symbol or decoration.

assets.postprocess: Crop the centered 20x20 safe area from the 32x32 API canvas without scaling.
assets.prompt: Use the supplied ring badge exactly. A single round mint UI badge contained entirely inside the centered 20 by 20 pixel safe area of this 32 by 32 transparent canvas. Preserve the supplied approved start-marker composition. A single mint quarter-view start marker made from four tiny toy arrows pointing inward to a blank center, visibly different from a coral goal marker, centered with a transparent margin, no text or number.

assets.postprocess: Pad five edge-colored rows at top and bottom to produce the specified 360x410 game canvas without scaling.
